name: The Williams–Buckler family tree
living_rule: no death record and born within the last 110 years: name and birth year only

versions.change: First edition: 12 people and 4 marked gaps over seven generations, each link with its record.

people.summary: Named in his widow Amy’s death notice of 1864 as the late Mr John Williams of Great House farm. A John Williams occupied the farm’s 36 parcels in the tithe apportionment of about 1841; whether that is this John or his son, then about 13, the record does not show.

spouse.basis: Amy is called his widow (“relict”) in her death notice, 30 Dec 1864 (EV-0246).

sources.label: Cardiff and Merthyr Guardian, 30 Dec 1864, p.5: death notice of Amy, “relict of the late Mr. John Williams, Great House farm”
Tithe apportionment, Landough, Cogan and Leckwith, c.1841: John Williams, occupier of 36 parcels

people.place: Born at Leckwith; farmer at Great House, Llandough
people.summary: Farmer at Great House. The 1881 census gives his age as 53 and his birthplace as Leckwith; the trade directories place him at Great House from 1868 to 1901. A 1904 report records that he succeeded his father in the tenancy in 1855. He died on 17 July 1908 and left a will, proved at Llandaff to his widow Mary.

parents.basis: The Cardiff Times of 16 July 1904 reports that he succeeded his father in the tenancy in 1855 (EV-0227). The father is not named there; Amy’s 1864 notice places a John Williams of Great House farm before then (EV-0246). Supported, not proved.
Amy was the widow of John Williams of Great House farm (EV-0246). No record yet found names her as this John’s mother.

spouse.basis: 1881 census, “his wife Mary” (EV-0224); probate of his will to “Mary Williams widow”, 1908.

people.summary: Wife of John Williams of Great House; born at Cogan, aged 51 in the 1881 census. As his widow she was “of Great House Farm” when she died on 23 December 1915. She is a different person from Mary Doreen (Nancy) Williams, her granddaughter on this tree, who was born in 1913.

sources.label: 1881 census, Llandough, RG11/5288 p.2: Mary, wife, 51, born Cogan
Probate calendar 1916, p.301: Mary Williams of Great House Farm, Llandough juxta Penarth, widow, died 23 December 1915, probate Llandaff 3 February 1916 to Ellen Williams (wife of Jenkin Williams)

people.name: Mary Williams

people.summary: Nancy Williams’s father. He held the farm from 1908; in February 1916 the Marquis of Bute granted him a yearly tenancy of “the whole of the farm”, and in May 1939 he made an agreement with Western Ground Rents. His tenancy of the fields was surrendered in 1949. The Court of Appeal in 1987 called him Mr Buckler junior’s maternal grandfather.

parents.basis: The 1881 census lists a son John, 13 (EV-0224). That he is the John Williams of the 1916 tenancy and Nancy’s father fits the dates and the succession to the farm in 1908, and Nancy’s own statement (c.1974) has her grandfather dying in 1908. No single record yet ties them.
As for his father: the 1881 census son John, 13 (EV-0224).

spouse.basis: Nancy’s mother is not yet found in the records.

people.summary: Born at Great House Farm on 10 August 1913 and lived there all her life. She married Fred Buckler of Barry in 1936 and they raised seven children in the farmhouse. After Fred’s death in 1967 she went back to her maiden name. She died at the farmhouse on 26 March 1983.

people.place: Birthplace: Yorkshire (family account; record not yet found). Of Barry; at Great House Farm from 1936
people.summary: Fred Buckler came from Barry and married Nancy Williams in 1936. From 1944 he ran the farm for his father-in-law, and from 1949 he held the fields as a yearly tenant. He died in 1967. The family account is that he was born in Yorkshire and that the Buckler line has Yorkshire roots; a birth record is not yet found.

people.summary: Son of Nancy and Fred, born on 25 August 1948. After his mother’s death in 1983 he took up the defence of the house, and he was the defendant in BP Properties Ltd v Buckler (Court of Appeal, 1987). A probate entry for a William Beverley Buckler who died on 29 April 1990 is probably his.
